svg.title: Three roots, equally spaced angles
svg.desc: The three roots of z cubed equals 8i are square root of 3 plus i, minus square root of 3 plus i, and minus 2i. They lie on the circle of radius two about the origin, at arguments pi over six, five pi over six, and three pi over two. Equal coordinate scales show their equilateral triangle accurately.
